description: This file defines the ACLRole class, which manages role-based access control within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for retrieving roles, assigning actions, and handling relationships between roles and users.

classes.name: ACLRole
classes.description: Represents a user role in the SuiteCRM ACL system, providing methods to manage role properties, retrieve user roles, get role actions, and handle relationships.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the name of the role as a string summary.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Sets the relationship and access level between a role and an action.

methods.name: getUserRoles
methods.description: Returns a list of ACLRoles objects or names for a specified user ID.

methods.name: getUserRoleNames
methods.description: Returns a list of role names for a specified user ID, utilizing cache.

methods.name: getAllRoles
methods.description: Retrieves all role records, optionally as arrays.

methods.name: getRoleActions
methods.description: Gets actions associated with a specific role, categorized and sorted.

methods.name: langCompare
methods.description: Helper function to compare module names for sorting based on localization.

methods.name: mark_relationships_deleted
methods.description: Deletes role-action relationships for a role.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the role's key fields as an array.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Populates role properties from an array.
